answer: To counter Sybil attacks, our network enforces quadratic stake burning for each registered identity. Each agent commits a zero-knowledge cipher of identity secrets to the ledger, and registering the n-th node requires burning tokens proportional to n squared. This superlinear cost scale creates a financial ledge that makes mass imitation prohibitively expensive. Even if an attacker cracks a cryptographic walnut, funding exponential clone swarms remains mathematically impossible.
